groups.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready 2D painted RTS building animation sprite atlas with genuine transparent alpha.
Input image is a design reference for these 5 building types, ordered left to right: commandHub, supplyDepot, barracks, academy, factory. Preserve each identifiable design and colors, but REMOVE ALL card borders, UI panels, terrain, labels, and backgrounds. This is not a preview: all sprites are for direct game use.
Create exactly 8 columns and 10 rows of equal 160x160 cells (1280x1600 full sheet). NO TEXT, no drawn grid, no labels, no outer margins. Strict cell registration. Overhead/three-quarter painted detailed non-pixel sci-fi art. Each independent frame stays entirely inside its own square with 10% clear padding, identical world viewpoint, same footprint centered x=80, grounded at y=130. Never overlap cells. Transparent empty space everywhere outside structures/effects.
Building assignments: rows 1-2 = commandHub; rows 3-4 = supplyDepot; rows 5-6 = barracks; rows 7-8 = academy; rows 9-10 = factory.
For EACH building TWO ROWS of EIGHT actual different frames:
FIRST ROW columns 1-4 are IDLE loop: mechanical radar/doors/vapor, flowing energy/crystal components, or biological membranes visibly changing, with stable masonry body. Columns 5-8 are ACTIVE PRODUCTION loop: opened production hatch machinery and welding/steam; strong swirling warp portal; organic sac opening spore/larva activity. If a defense building use columns 5-8 as actual ATTACK cycle with winding/firing/recoil/recover.
SECOND ROW columns 1-4 are progressive CONSTRUCTION: foundation and scaffolds/energy wire outline/organic bud (20%), half-height shell (45%), nearly assembled incomplete (75%), complete building (100%). Columns 5-8 are DESTRUCTION: first obvious cracked structure, large collapsing broken parts and faction appropriate sparks/blue energy or organic spray, lower crumpling ruins, final low shattered debris. Must show changed silhouette and parts, no fake translated/zoomed static picture.
Specific buildings: Command Hub: gray steel tiered command fortress with central cyan crest and antenna. Supply Depot: squat yellow-trim cargo depot with large cylindrical supply containers. Barracks: rectangular gray armored recruitment hangar, blue-lit door ramp. Tactical Academy: tall sloping communications training tower with blue holographic side consoles. Factory: wide heavy mechanized assembly plant with raised internal gantries.
All 16 frames of every building required. Frame consistency is more important than tiny details. Do not omit lower rows. Keep animation transitions clear at 128 pixel display size. True transparent background.

Columns 5-8 = real DESTRUCTION sequence first cracked wounded building, collapsing/splitting architecture with organic spray or spark fragments, lower crumpled ruins, final low rubble. Spawning Pool: low purple living ring enclosing luminous green biological fluid. Hydra Den: tall curved purple chitin claws and orange membranes. Evolution Nest: low asymmetrical organic laboratory with green and orange bubbling sacs.
All five structures with all 16 frames REQUIRED. Keep sheet grid exact and all 10 rows present; modest clear padding within every cell. True transparent background with no baked checkerboard.
